drills.name: Passing Diamond
drills.description: Four players form a diamond shape and pass the ball around with one touch
drills.setup: Place 4 cones in a diamond shape, 10 yards apart. One player on each cone.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and movement off the ball

drills.name: One Touch Wall Passing
drills.description: Pass the ball to the rebounder or wall with one touch. Make sure to alternate feet with each pass.
drills.setup: Find a wall or rebounder and pass the ball from about 4-5 feet away.
drills.reps: 5 minutes with both feet, or 2.5 minutes with each foot
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and ball control

drills.name: Two Touch Wall Passing
drills.description: Recieve the ball with your foot and touch it across to the other and then pass the ball to the rebounder or wall.
drills.setup: Find a wall or rebounder and pass the ball from about 4-5 feet away.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and ball control

drills.name: Cone Wall Passing (One Touch)
drills.description: Pass the ball to the rebounder or wall with one touch diagonally. Move to the other side of the cone and repeat. Make sure to alternate feet with each pass.
drills.setup: Find a wall or rebounder and pass the ball from about 4-5 feet away. Place a cone about 1-2 feet away from the wall.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and ball control

drills.name: Cone Wall Passing (Two Touch)
drills.description: Pass the ball to the rebounder or wall diagonally. Move to the other side of the cone, recieve, and repeat. Make sure to alternate feet with each pass.
drills.setup: Find a wall or rebounder and pass the ball from about 4-5 feet away. Place a cone about 1-2 feet away from the wall.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and ball control

drills.name: Juggling
drills.description: Juggle the ball in the air using both feet. Try not to let the ball drop.
drills.setup: Find an open space and a ball.
drills.objective: Improves ball control, first touch, and your weak foot.

drills.name: Wall Juggling
drills.description: Juggle the ball in the air using both feet. Pass the ball to the wall so it comes back to you. Try not to let the ball drop.
drills.setup: Find an open space with a wall and a ball.
drills.objective: Improves ball control, first touch, passing in the air, and your weak foot.

drills.name: Receiving Turn
drills.description: Pass the ball against the rebounder then receive and turn with the ball and then explode with the ball. Try not to turn to close to the cone or too far.
drills.setup: Find an open space with a rebounder. Place a cone 8-10 feet away from the rebounder. Stand about 1 foot in front of the cone.
drills.reps: 3 sets of 15 reps for each foot.
drills.objective: Improves passing, first touch, recieving, and your weak foot.

drills.name: 1v1 Shielding Drill
drills.description: One player shields the ball while the other tries to win it
drills.setup: Mark a 5x5 yard box with cones. Attacker shields inside, defender outside.
drills.objective: Improve body positioning and ball protection under pressure

drills.name: Cone Dribbling Course
drills.description: Dribble through a line of cones as fast as possible with close control
drills.setup: Place 8 cones in a straight line, 1 yard apart.
drills.reps: 10 runs, alternating left and right foot
drills.objective: Improve close ball control and weak foot ability

drills.name: Finishing Under Pressure
drills.description: Striker receives a pass and must shoot before a defender closes them down
drills.setup: Striker starts 20 yards from goal. Feeder passes the ball. Defender starts 5 yards behind.
drills.objective: Improve composure and decision making in front of goal

drills.name: Defensive Shape Drill
drills.description: Defensive unit holds their shape while attackers try to find gaps
drills.setup: 3 defenders vs 3 attackers in half pitch. Defenders must stay compact.
drills.objective: Improve defensive communication and positional awareness

drills.name: First Touch Control
drills.description: Player receives balls from different heights and angles and controls with one touch
drills.setup: Two players face each other 10 yards apart. Server throws or kicks varied balls.
drills.objective: Improve first touch in all directions

drills.name: Pressing Trigger Drill
drills.description: Team presses immediately after losing the ball to win it back quickly
drills.setup: 4v2 in a 15x15 yard box. When possession is lost, both players press immediately.
drills.objective: Improve pressing triggers and high intensity defending

drills.name: Weak Foot Passing Wall
drills.description: Player passes against a wall repeatedly using only their weak foot
drills.setup: Stand 5 yards from a wall. Pass and control on the rebound.
drills.objective: Build confidence and accuracy with the weak foot

drills.name: Figure 8 (Right)
drills.description: Player passes against a wall repeatedly using only their weak foot
drills.setup: Stand 5 yards from a wall. Pass and control on the rebound.
drills.objective: Build confidence and accuracy with the weak foot
